findings.description: `"strict": true` changed to `false`, turning off strict null checks and implicit-any checks for the whole app. This breaks mandate 11 and lets type errors through `tsc -b --noEmit`.
findings.failureMode: Type errors such as null dereferences now pass validate:types in CI
findings.title: Strict type checking disabled

findings.description: Work pool and work queue status fields always bind to trigger.expect. For Proactive posture, the deployment and flow-run components switch to trigger.after, but these two do not. A Proactive work-pool/work-queue trigger therefore puts the status in expect and leaves after empty, which gives the wrong trigger semantics. The same issue is in work-queue-status-trigger-fields.tsx line 36. Fix: pick the field name from posture, as the deployment component does.
findings.failureMode: Proactive work pool/queue trigger saved with wrong expect/after fields
findings.title: Proactive posture writes status to expect, not after

findings.description: String.split("\n") always returns at least one element, so `lines.length > 0` is always true and the undefined branch can never run. An empty textarea saves expect=[""], and blank lines add empty event names, so the trigger expects an event named "". Fix: filter out empty or whitespace-only lines, and use undefined when none remain.
findings.failureMode: Automation saved with expect [""] never matches events
findings.title: Empty textarea stores [""] instead of undefined

findings.description: Only this component uses parseInt; its siblings use Number. Clearing the field stores NaN in the form, so the controlled input gets a NaN value and zod validation fails. Decimals are also silently truncated. Fix: use Number(e.target.value) like the other components.
findings.failureMode: Clearing threshold stores NaN in the form state
findings.title: parseInt on threshold yields NaN for empty input

findings.description: Removed `config_metadata.inner = serde_json::from_value(value)...`; merged `value` is discarded and inner is unchanged.
findings.failureMode: --config overrides in Xcode/Android Studio scripts are ignored for the build.
findings.title: merge_with no longer applies merged config

findings.description: `||` changed to `&&`; an extension can't equal both json and json5, so schema validation is skipped for every config.
findings.failureMode: Invalid tauri.conf.json no longer reports schema errors or exits.
findings.title: Schema validation condition never true

findings.description: Key changed from "identifier" to "bundle"; bundle is an object so as_str() yields None and original_identifier() is always None.
findings.failureMode: Mobile dev/build fails with "app configuration is missing an identifier" in mobile/mod.rs.
findings.title: original_identifier reads "bundle" key

findings.description: The schema-parse line is well over 100 chars; `cargo fmt --check` would reformat it, violating mandate 3.
findings.failureMode: Format CI check fails.
findings.title: Line exceeds rustfmt max_width

findings.description: @Roles("TEAM_MEMBER") lets plain MEMBER users create invite links; intended TEAM_ADMIN (e2e expects 403 for member).
findings.failureMode: Non-admin member POSTs /v2/teams/:id/invite and gets a valid join token -> authorization bypass.
findings.title: Invite endpoint allows any team member, not just admins

findings.description: `token: newToken.identifier` returns "invite-link-for-teamId-N" instead of the random token; affects tRPC and both API controllers.
findings.failureMode: Callers receive an unusable, identical-per-team token string; token != inviteLink token.
findings.title: createInvite returns identifier instead of token

findings.description: Changed `if (!isOrgContext)` to `if (isOrgContext)`: org teams now get /teams link and regular teams get /signup link.
findings.failureMode: Every invite link (tRPC and API) routes to the wrong flow for both team types.
findings.title: Inverted org-context condition in buildInviteLink

findings.description: The deleted base line was `keyword[:30].encode('unicode_escape')...replace(r"\u", r"\\u")`. It existed because WorkflowRun.inputs/outputs are written with json.dumps (ensure_ascii=True), so non-ASCII text is stored as \uXXXX. The new code searches for the raw characters, so a keyword such as a Chinese word never matches the stored inputs or outputs. Fix: apply the unicode_escape encoding to the keyword before escape_like_pattern.
findings.failureMode: Workflow log keyword search for non-ASCII text returns empty results.
findings.title: Dropped unicode_escape breaks non-ASCII keyword search

findings.description: escape_like_pattern inserts backslashes, but the SQL declares ESCAPE '|'. Backslashes become literal characters and %/_ remain wildcards, so a query like "50%" becomes "%50\%%" and only matches text that contains a literal backslash. Fix: use ESCAPE '\'.
findings.failureMode: Fallback full-text search returns no results for queries that contain %, _ or \.
findings.title: IRIS LIKE uses ESCAPE '|' but pattern escaped with backslash

findings.description: The other three LIKE branches pass escape="\\", but the "not contains" branch calls notlike on the escaped value without it. The backslash escapes are therefore only honored where the backend's default LIKE escape happens to be backslash. Anywhere else, the literal backslashes change the pattern and the filter matches the wrong documents. Fix: add escape="\\".
findings.failureMode: Negated metadata filters can match incorrectly for values that contain %, _ or \.
findings.title: "not contains" notlike missing escape="\\"

findings.description: `escapedPattern` breaks mandate rule 16, which requires snake_case for variables. Rename it to escaped_pattern.
findings.failureMode: Repository naming mandate violation
findings.title: camelCase variable violates snake_case mandate

findings.description: Rule now blocks all @calcom/trpc/** at error level, but ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx:12 and SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx:6 still import "@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell"; the diff does not migrate them.
findings.failureMode: `biome lint` (lint / pre-commit with --error-on-warnings) fails with noRestrictedImports errors on two unchanged atoms files.
findings.title: Broadened trpc ban breaks lint on existing atoms imports

findings.description: Removed trpc Slot had `userIds?: number[]`; slot engine produces numeric user ids (TimeFrame/slots.ts `userIds?: number[]`). New copy declares string[], so the public onTimeslotsLoaded callback type misdescribes runtime data.
findings.failureMode: Consumer code like `slot.userIds?.includes(String(id))` type-checks but never matches because runtime values are numbers; numeric comparisons fail to compile.
findings.title: Slot.userIds retyped from number[] to string[]

findings.description: validateCreateScheduleInput throws plain `new Error(...)` (mandate 10 requires typed error classes with code/status) and uses single-quoted strings where biome quoteStyle is "double" (mandate 3). It also only checks name, then casts schedule/eventTypeId unvalidated.

findings.failureMode: testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection fails on navigation

findings.description: Deleted `checkCopiedUrl()` after copyUrl(); pasteboard-vs-URL-bar assertion is gone and checkCopiedUrl is dead code.
findings.failureMode: Lost coverage: wrong clipboard content passes
findings.title: testClipboard no longer verifies copied URL

findings.failureMode: Mandate violation (access control/documentation)
findings.title: Helpers needlessly made public, undocumented

findings.description: handleShowReaderModeAction was changed from `.readerMode` to `.readerModeLongPressAction`. BVC maps that to toggleReaderModeLongPressAction(), so tapping the reader mode button adds the page to the reading list and never calls toggleReaderMode(). Fix: restore `displayView: .readerMode`.

findings.title: Reader mode tap now adds to reading list instead of toggling

findings.description: The condition changed from `isWebPage() && !isReaderModeURL` to `isWebPage() || isReaderModeURL`. The internal localhost reader-mode URL now reaches the cancelEdit ToolbarAction. Tapping tabs, menu, or cancel while a reader-mode page is open therefore shows the internal URL in the address bar. Fix: restore `&& !currentURL.isReaderModeURL`.

findings.title: cancelEditMode now keeps reader-mode URLs

findings.description: The values in the switch were swapped. `.available` means the tap turns reader mode on, but it now records isEnabled=false, and closing reader mode records true. As a result, every readerModeButtonTapped event reports the wrong enabled value. Fix: restore `.available: true`, `default: false`.
findings.failureMode: Wrong telemetry value on every reader mode tap
findings.title: Reader mode telemetry enabled flag inverted

findings.description: The diff drops `private` from `gleanWrapper`, so this implementation detail is now exposed module-wide with no caller that needs it. This violates AGENTS.md rule 11, which requires `private` for implementation details. Fix: restore `private let`.
findings.failureMode: Access-control mandate violation
findings.title: gleanWrapper access widened from private

findings.failureMode: Reload/share/reader-mode trailing buttons stay invisible (alpha 0) after configure.

findings.failureMode: With swiping tabs enabled, Auto Layout conflict; toolbar laid out wrongly/breaks constraints.

findings.failureMode: With trailing actions and no leading ones, divider collapses to 0; with leading-only, a stray divider appears.

findings.failureMode: Build warnings; dead code with no layout effect.

findings.description: For testSelectBottomPlacement and every iPad run (iOS 17+), tearDown returns before app.terminate() and super.tearDown(); base always ran them.
findings.failureMode: App stays running and BaseTestCase teardown is skipped, leaking state into subsequent tests.
findings.title: Early return in tearDown skips app.terminate and super.tearDown

findings.description: verifyBookmarksShareNormalWebsiteReminders is no longer discovered by XCTest, while AccessibilityTestPlan still lists testBookmarksShareNormalWebsiteReminders (line 371). Violates mandate 6 test naming.
findings.failureMode: Coverage for TestRail 2864380 silently dropped; stale plan entry.
findings.title: Renamed test lacks 'test' prefix; silently disabled

findings.description: Moved Slot changes deleted `userIds?: number[];` to `userIds?: string[]`. getSchedule passes numeric userIds through (util.ts `userIds?: number[]`). Public `onTimeslotsLoaded(slots: Record<string, Slot[]>)` now advertises the wrong type; consumer code like `slot.userIds?.includes(String(id))` compiles but always returns false. Fix: `userIds?: number[]`.
findings.failureMode: Wrong public type contract for slot userIds leading to wrong comparisons in consumers.
findings.title: Slot.userIds typed string[] but runtime/base is number[]

findings.description: Rule now errors on all `@calcom/trpc/**`, but atoms still imports `@calcom/trpc/components/QueryCell` in ConferencingAppsViewPlatformWrapper.tsx:12 and SelectedCalendarsSettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx:6. `biome lint` (level error) fails for these files; PR didn't migrate them.
findings.failureMode: Lint/CI failure on unchanged atoms files.
findings.title: Broadened trpc ban breaks lint on existing atoms files

findings.description: Replacement for GetAvailabilityListHandlerReturn declares `days: string[]`; list.handler returns Prisma Availability where `days Int[]`. Consumers of useAtomGetAllSchedules get a wrong type (e.g. `days.includes(1)` fails to compile; string comparisons always false). Fix: `days: number[]`.
findings.failureMode: Type contract drifts from actual API payload.
findings.title: availability.days typed string[] but Prisma returns number[]

findings.description: OOO slot `fromUser` is built as `{ id: user.id, displayName }` (number), and `toUser.id` right below is `number`. New local type says `id: string`, so consumers of useAvailableSlots data comparing `fromUser.id === someUserIdString` never match. Fix: `id: number`.
findings.failureMode: Type drift from actual payload for OOO slots.
findings.title: SlotInfo.fromUser.id typed string but is numeric user id

findings.description: New validator throws `new Error(...)`, violating mandate 10 (typed error classes); also hand-rolled validation diverges from ZCreateInputSchema (rejects empty name, skips schedule/eventTypeId checks) and casts unvalidated data. Use ErrorWithCode/Zod schema.
findings.failureMode: Uncategorized generic errors; unvalidated fields cast through.
findings.title: validateCreateScheduleInput throws generic Error

findings.description: The pool moves to macOS-15 and the step is renamed "Use XCode 16.4.0", but the script still runs `xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.2.0.app`. macOS-15 images do not ship Xcode 15.2, so xcode-select fails and the macOS build breaks. At best the step does not do what its name says. The same problem is at line 393. Fix: point both scripts at Xcode_16.4.app.
findings.failureMode: macOS CI job fails at the xcode-select step or uses the wrong Xcode
findings.title: macOS-15 jobs still select Xcode 15.2

findings.description: The new condition `'$(AspNetCorePatchVersion)' == '1'` means BUILD002 (removed package references in a servicing update) only fires for 10.0.1. From 10.0.2 onward, dropping a package reference in a servicing build no longer fails the build, so a breaking dependency removal can ship unnoticed. This weakens an enforcement check.
findings.failureMode: Servicing builds with patch >= 2 silently allow removed package references
findings.title: BUILD002 servicing check limited to patch 1

findings.description: `namespace ...ServerExecutionTests;` becomes a braced block namespace, which breaks mandatory AGENTS.md rule 2 (use file-scoped namespaces). Adding the QuarantinedTest using and attribute does not need this change. Fix: go back to the file-scoped declaration.
findings.failureMode: Violates the mandated file-scoped namespace convention
findings.title: File-scoped namespace replaced by block namespace

findings.description: MagicLink.js was not renamed (still services/lib/magic-link/MagicLink.js), but the require now points to magic-link/magic-link. On case-sensitive filesystems this throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND when the members API loads, so Ghost fails to start.
findings.failureMode: MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash on startup
findings.title: require of non-existent magic-link/magic-link

findings.description: email-service/EmailEventStorage.js and EmailEventProcessor.js were not renamed, yet the wrapper now requires '../email-service/email-event-storage' and '../email-service/email-event-processor'. init() throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND on case-sensitive filesystems, breaking email analytics startup.
findings.failureMode: MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash in EmailAnalyticsServiceWrapper.init
findings.title: Requires of unrenamed EmailEventStorage/EmailEventProcessor

findings.description: DonationBookshelfRepository.ts was renamed to donation-bookshelf-repository.ts, but donation-service-wrapper.js line 11 still does require('./DonationBookshelfRepository'). Donation service init fails with MODULE_NOT_FOUND on case-sensitive filesystems.
findings.failureMode: MODULE_NOT_FOUND when donations service initializes
findings.title: Renamed repository still required as ./DonationBookshelfRepository

findings.description: Lines 1-10 dropped trailing semicolons (base had e.g. `const {Router} = require('express');`), which breaks the repo's required-semicolons rule and fails the lint check.
findings.failureMode: Lint failure / semicolon mandate violation
findings.title: Semicolons removed from require statements

findings.description: @Roles("TEAM_MEMBER") lets any non-admin member mint team invite links; intended TEAM_ADMIN (sibling org invite controller uses TEAM_ADMIN; e2e expects 403 for MEMBER).
findings.failureMode: Authorization bypass: MEMBER role receives 200 and a valid invite token.
findings.title: Invite endpoint requires only TEAM_MEMBER

findings.description: `token: newToken.identifier` returns "invite-link-for-teamId-N" rather than the random token; it is identical across calls and not usable for joining. Should return newToken.token.
findings.failureMode: API/tRPC callers receive a non-secret constant string instead of the invite token.
findings.title: createInvite returns identifier instead of token

findings.description: Condition changed from `if (!isOrgContext)` to `if (isOrgContext)`: regular teams now get /signup links and org/sub-teams get /teams links, swapping both flows.
findings.failureMode: Wrong invite link for every team; affects existing callers of createInvite too.
findings.title: Inverted org-context check in buildInviteLink

findings.description: Loop changed from `j < numkeys` to `j <= numkeys`. Last iteration reads keys[numkeys] (stale/uninitialized), dereferences argv[garbage pos], and writes slot_buffer[numkeys] past the malloc'd buffer. Fix: `j < keys_result->numkeys`.
findings.failureMode: Any keyed command in cluster mode (preprocessCommand, getSlotFromCommand) triggers OOB reads and a heap overflow: crash/heap corruption or spurious CROSSSLOT.
findings.title: Off-by-one loop reads/writes past arrays

findings.description: New slot_buffer uses malloc() (line 1110) and free() (lines 1120, 1124), violating AGENTS.md rule 2 (zmalloc/zfree only); allocation is untracked and unchecked. The buffer is write-only. Fix: drop the buffer or use zmalloc/zfree.
findings.failureMode: Memory untracked by Redis accounting; unchecked NULL from malloc dereferenced on OOM.
findings.title: Direct malloc/free violates zmalloc mandate

findings.description: Rename replaced `pageActionStack.arrangedSubviews` with `browserActionStack.arrangedSubviews` (duplicate) instead of `trailingPageActionStack`. New trailing buttons get alpha 0 in updateActionStack and are never set to 1.
findings.failureMode: Reload/share/reader-mode trailing page actions stay invisible (alpha 0).
findings.title: Trailing page action buttons never faded in

findings.description: Changed from `leftSkeletonAddressBar.trailingAnchor` to `rightSkeletonAddressBar.trailingAnchor`, while trailing is pinned to rightSkeleton.leadingAnchor, giving toolbar negative width (unsatisfiable constraints).
findings.failureMode: With swiping tabs enabled, Auto Layout breaks constraints; address toolbar laid out wrong.
findings.title: Toolbar leading anchored to right skeleton

findings.description: `hasPageActions` now checks `leadingPageActionStack` instead of the trailing stack (formerly `pageActionStack`). The divider sits before the trailing stack, so it is hidden when trailing actions exist and no leading ones, and shown when only leading actions exist.
findings.failureMode: Divider between URL and trailing page actions shown/hidden incorrectly.
findings.title: Divider width keyed on wrong stack

findings.description: `isLandscape` is never used and calls deprecated `statusBarOrientation`; produces compiler warnings (unused variable, deprecation) contrary to lint-clean mandate.
findings.failureMode: Build warnings; dead code in a PR claiming to remove unused code.
findings.title: Unused deprecated isLandscape variable

findings.description: escape_like_pattern emits backslash escapes (\%, \_, \\), but the SQL declares ESCAPE '|'. The backslashes are treated as literal characters, so a query like "50%" becomes "%50\%%", matching only text containing "50\". Any query with %, _ or \ fails to find its matching documents. Fix: change the clause to ESCAPE '\'.
findings.failureMode: Full-text fallback returns no results for queries containing %, _ or backslash
findings.title: IRIS LIKE uses ESCAPE '|' but pattern escaped with backslash

findings.description: The base code applied keyword[:30].encode('unicode_escape') and then converted \u to \\u. It did this because WorkflowRun.inputs/outputs are stored with json.dumps (default ensure_ascii=True, e.g. models/workflow.py:702), so non-ASCII text is stored as \uXXXX. The new code matches the raw keyword instead, so a search for Chinese text such as "你好" no longer matches any stored run. Fix: apply unicode_escape before escape_like_pattern.
findings.failureMode: Non-ASCII keyword searches of workflow app logs return zero results
findings.title: Dropped unicode_escape breaks non-ASCII keyword search in workflow logs

findings.description: The value is escaped with backslashes, but unlike the three sibling like() calls, notlike() declares no ESCAPE clause. The escaping therefore relies on the database's default escape character. On a backend without a backslash default, "\%" is compared literally and the negation filter is wrong. Fix: pass escape="\\" to match the other branches.
findings.failureMode: Inconsistent escape handling in the metadata "not contains" filter
findings.title: "not contains" notlike missing escape="\\"

findings.description: The local variable `escapedPattern` breaks mandate 16, which requires snake_case for variables. Rename it to escaped_pattern.
findings.failureMode: Repository naming rule violation
findings.title: camelCase local variable violates snake_case mandate

findings.description: `j <= numkeys` reads keys[numkeys] (stale/zero pos) and writes slot_buffer[numkeys] past the malloc'd buffer on every cluster-mode command with keys.
findings.failureMode: Heap overflow / OOB argv deref → crash, or spurious CROSSSLOT for single-slot commands.
findings.title: Off-by-one loop reads/writes past arrays

findings.description: New slot_buffer uses malloc()/free() (lines 1111, 1120, 1124) instead of zmalloc/zfree, violating AGENTS.md rule 2; allocation is also unchecked for NULL and untracked by used_memory.
findings.failureMode: Untracked memory; NULL deref on allocation failure.
findings.title: Direct malloc/free violates zmalloc mandate

findings.description: Changes "strict": true to false, disabling strict null/implicit-any checks for the whole ui-v2 app; violates mandate 11 and weakens the validate:types enforcement.
findings.failureMode: Type errors (e.g. null derefs) across ui-v2 no longer fail tsc -b --noEmit.
findings.title: Strict type checking disabled

findings.description: split("\n") always returns at least one element, so the undefined branch never runs. A cleared textarea stores [""], and blank or trailing lines store "" entries in trigger.expect. Filter out empty lines for the saved value and store undefined when nothing is left.
findings.failureMode: Clearing the textarea yields expect=[""], so the trigger expects an event named "" instead of any event.
findings.title: Empty lines saved as empty event names

findings.description: Threshold uses parseInt unlike every sibling (Number). Clearing the input gives parseInt("") = NaN stored in the form, and decimals are silently truncated; fix by using Number(e.target.value) like the other fields.
findings.failureMode: Empty threshold input stores NaN into trigger.threshold.
findings.title: parseInt yields NaN threshold

findings.description: The new `AND '$(AspNetCorePatchVersion)' == '1'` means the check for package references removed during servicing only runs for 10.0.1. From 10.0.2 on, removed baseline references (breaking changes in servicing) no longer fail the build. The condition looks inverted: the exemption was meant for the first servicing build (`!= '1'`). Fix: use `!= '1'`.
findings.failureMode: A servicing-breaking removal of a package reference goes undetected in every patch after .1
findings.title: BUILD002 servicing check now runs only when patch is 1

findings.description: The pool moved to macOS-15 and the step was renamed "Use XCode 16.4.0", but the script still runs `xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode_15.2.0.app`. macOS-15 hosted images ship only Xcode 16.x, so xcode-select fails and macOS jobs break. If it doesn't fail, the wrong Xcode is used and the step name is wrong. Same defect at lines 392-393. Fix: point both scripts at Xcode_16.4.0.app.
findings.failureMode: macOS CI build fails at xcode-select, or runs with a mislabeled Xcode
findings.title: macOS-15 jobs still select Xcode 15.2.0

findings.description: The file-scoped `namespace ...ServerExecutionTests;` was changed to a braced block namespace. AGENTS.md rule 2 requires file-scoped namespaces. Fix: go back to the file-scoped declaration and remove the trailing brace.
findings.failureMode: Violates mandatory repository rule 2
findings.title: File-scoped namespace replaced with block namespace

findings.description: The diff deletes `struct UX { static let buttonSize: CGFloat = 40 }` and replaces `UX.buttonSize` with a hard-coded `40` in both the height and width constraints. AGENTS.md rule 13 requires UI constants to be defined in a nested UX struct. The size is now duplicated in two places, so changing one without the other can give the button a non-square frame.
findings.failureMode: Violates mandate 13 (magic numbers scattered as literals); duplicated constant can drift
findings.title: Close-button size moved out of UX struct into magic literals

findings.description: rewriteClientCommandVector(c, 6, hsetex, key, KEEPTTL, FIELDS, 1, field, newobj) passes 7 objects; only first 6 used, so propagated command is HSETEX key KEEPTTL FIELDS 1 field without value (newobj leaked/ignored). Should be argc 7.

findings.failureMode: Mandate violation; inconsistent error handling.

findings.description: Changed to require '../../lib/magic-link/magic-link', but the file is still MagicLink.js. Loading members-api throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND on case-sensitive filesystems, which breaks the members service at boot.

On a case-sensitive filesystem init() throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND, so email analytics fails to start.
findings.failureMode: MODULE_NOT_FOUND crash in EmailAnalyticsServiceWrapper.init
findings.title: Requires non-existent email-event-storage/processor

findings.description: This PR renamed DonationBookshelfRepository.ts to donation-bookshelf-repository.ts, but donation-service-wrapper.js still calls require('./DonationBookshelfRepository'). On case-sensitive filesystems, donations init() throws MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findings.failureMode: MODULE_NOT_FOUND in DonationServiceWrapper.init
findings.title: Renamed repository breaks DonationServiceWrapper require

findings.description: The rewritten lines 1-10 drop their trailing semicolons (e.g. `const {Router} = require('express')`). This breaks mandate 19 (always use semicolons), and the ESLint semi rule will fail lint.
findings.failureMode: Lint failure / mandate violation
findings.title: Semicolons removed from require statements

findings.description: The diff deletes `struct UX { static let buttonSize: CGFloat = 40 }` and hardcodes `40` in the close-button constraints. This breaks AGENTS.md rule 13, which says UI constants must live in a nested UX struct.
findings.failureMode: Mandate violation: the button size is now a scattered literal duplicated in two places instead of one constant.
findings.title: UX constant replaced by magic literal 40

findings.description: After SelectLightTheme, lightIsSelected reads darkThemeView (base used lightThemeView) and asserts "1". The dark button is "0" when light is selected, so the assertion fails every run, and the light-selection check is never actually performed.
findings.failureMode: testCheckSystemThemeChanges fails deterministically
findings.title: Light-mode check reads darkThemeView

findings.description: checkUrl (line 11), copyUrl (line 17) and checkCopiedUrl (line 41) were changed to `public`. They are used only inside this internal test class, which breaks mandate 11's rule against marking internal-only members public. They should be `private`.
findings.failureMode: Access-control mandate violation
findings.title: Internal helpers made public (AGENTS rule 11)

findings.description: handleShowReaderModeAction was changed from `displayView: .readerMode` to `.readerModeLongPressAction`. Tapping the reader mode button dispatches showReaderMode, so BVC now runs toggleReaderModeLongPressAction(), which adds the page to the reading list, instead of toggleReaderMode(). Reader mode can no longer be opened from the toolbar.
findings.failureMode: Tapping reader mode adds the page to the reading list and does not enter reader mode
findings.title: Reader mode tap now maps to long-press action

findings.description: The base check `currentURL.isWebPage() && !currentURL.isReaderModeURL` became `isWebPage() || isReaderModeURL`. When the user cancels editing (for example by tapping tabs or menu) on a reader-mode page, the internal localhost reader URL is now sent in the cancelEdit action and shown in the address bar. Previously the URL was cleared to nil.
findings.failureMode: Internal reader-mode URL is shown in the address bar after cancelling edit mode
findings.title: cancelEditMode condition inverted for reader-mode URLs

findings.description: The switch changed from `.available: true / default: false` to `.available: false / default: true`. When the state is .available, a tap opens reader mode, but telemetry now records enabled=false. This contradicts the inline comment "will be enabled after action gets executed", and every reader_mode_button_tapped event records the opposite value.
findings.failureMode: Glean readerModeButtonTapped records the opposite enabled value
findings.title: Reader mode telemetry `enabled` value inverted

findings.description: `private let gleanWrapper` became `let gleanWrapper`, which exposes an implementation detail to the whole module. This violates AGENTS.md rule 11 (use private for implementation details), and nothing in the diff needs the wider access.
findings.failureMode: Access-control mandate violation; internal telemetry dependency exposed module-wide
findings.title: gleanWrapper widened from private to internal

findings.description: On iOS 17+, for testSelectBottomPlacement and every test on iPad, `return` exits tearDown before `app.terminate()` and `try await super.tearDown()`, so BaseTestCase/XCTestCase teardown never runs. Only the theme switch was supposed to be skipped; move the terminate/super calls out or drop the return.
findings.failureMode: App left running and base teardown skipped for all iPad OnboardingTests and testSelectBottomPlacement.
findings.title: Early return in tearDown skips app.terminate and super.tearDown

findings.description: Renaming to `verifyBookmarksShareNormalWebsiteReminders` drops the `test` prefix, so XCTest no longer runs it. AccessibilityTestPlan.xctestplan still lists `testBookmarksShareNormalWebsiteReminders()`, which now points at a method that doesn't exist. Coverage is lost without anyone noticing.
findings.failureMode: Test silently never runs; test plan references a missing test.
findings.title: Renamed test no longer discovered; test plan entry stale

findings.description: HASH_SET_KEEP_TTL was removed from the hashTypeSet call, so HINCRBYFLOAT on a field that has a TTL clears that TTL on the master. The replica gets HSETEX KEEPTTL and keeps the TTL, so the two sides still disagree.
findings.failureMode: HSETEX h1 EX 100 FIELDS 1 f1 1; HINCRBYFLOAT h1 f1 1.1 -> HTTL on the master returns -1 while the replica returns about 100.
findings.title: HINCRBYFLOAT drops field TTL on master

findings.description: The diff removes `static` from addHashFieldToReply, but it is only used inside t_hash.c. That breaks AGENTS.md rule 7 and exports the symbol to other compilation units for no reason.
findings.failureMode: An internal helper symbol is exported, which violates the mandatory static-helper rule.
findings.title: addHashFieldToReply no longer static

findings.description: prepare_tools returns crate::Result and uses `?` on write_and_make_executable, but crate::Error has no From<FileWriteError> (grep finds none); Linux build fails. Also violates thiserror mandate.
findings.failureMode: tauri-bundler fails to compile on Linux
findings.title: No From<FileWriteError> for crate::Error — compile error

findings.description: Order swapped vs base: set_permissions runs before fs::write, so on a new path it fails with ENOENT; every tool write (AppRun, linuxdeploy, plugins) errors. Even if it existed, fs::write doesn't create with 0o770 mode.
findings.failureMode: All tool installs fail on first run
findings.title: set_permissions before file exists

findings.description: Base was `if !gtk.exists()`. Now the gtk plugin is written only if already present; fresh tools dir never gets linuxdeploy-plugin-gtk.sh, so `--plugin gtk` fails.
findings.failureMode: AppImage bundling fails on clean machines
findings.title: Inverted gtk.exists() check

findings.description: Base downloaded `linuxdeploy-{linuxdeploy_arch}.AppImage`; now `{arch}`. On i686 it requests linuxdeploy-i686.AppImage rather than the published i383 asset, so download fails.
findings.failureMode: i686 AppImage bundling fails with download error
findings.title: linuxdeploy URL uses arch instead of linuxdeploy_arch

findings.description: An extension cannot be both json and json5, so the condition is always false and tauri.conf.json is never validated; invalid configs no longer error/exit.
findings.failureMode: Schema validation silently skipped.
findings.title: `||` changed to `&&` disables schema validation

findings.description: Deleted `config_metadata.inner = serde_json::from_value(value)...`; the merged `value` is discarded so the --config overrides from Xcode/Android Studio scripts never reach the in-memory config.
findings.failureMode: Config overrides ignored during mobile builds.
findings.title: merge_with no longer applies merged config

findings.description: `bundle` is an object, so as_str() always returns None; original_identifier() is always None, breaking mobile identifier-overwrite checks in mobile/mod.rs.
findings.failureMode: Wrong identifier result on mainline mobile path.
findings.title: original_identifier reads "bundle" instead of "identifier"

findings.description: The single-line `serde_json::from_str(...).expect(...)` is well over 100 chars; `cargo fmt --all -- --check` would reformat it, failing the mandated format check.
findings.failureMode: CI format check failure.
findings.title: Line exceeds rustfmt max_width; fmt check fails
